summary: The construction price on {project} leaves out the people who must draw it, bid it and check the work.
realLife: Oakland budgeted staff costs separately when it priced delivery of its five-year construction program.
gates: The city manages the affected street and has the project facts described here.
inGame: The city highways budget records the appropriation change. needs: construction estimate and delivery costs for design, procurement and inspection.

turns.pulledBy: The city increases its street appropriation and the following records identify an eligible use: construction estimate and delivery costs for design, procurement and inspection.
turns.what: Add delivery hours to the appropriation before authorizing the new package.
turns.writesBack: Appropriation split between delivery and construction.

turns.pulledBy: A smaller city appropriation requires the office to revisit the commitment documented by these records: construction estimate and delivery costs for design, procurement and inspection.
turns.what: Recalculate the deliverable construction scope after reserving required oversight hours.
turns.writesBack: Appropriation split between delivery and construction.
